skill.name: Commit/Attack
skill.strategic_description: The player commits to an attack/engagement, leading to close enemy interaction: the enemy becomes an active approaching zombie while the player often ends in a knocked-down combat state.

steps: Identify a nearby target and current engagement distance
Choose to initiate direct close-range engagement now
Advance into contact while sustaining offensive pressure
Confirm the target is actively engaged at close range
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Press A to Attack
contract.description: Press **A** to throw a punch or kick straight ahead, damaging nearby enemies and breakable objects. Use it whenever foes are within striking distance or to finish enemies after moving into close range.
